_about: Interface labels for the ELSA planning exercise. Translators: change only the text on the right. Keep words in {curly brackets} exactly as they are.
load_error: The exercise could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
grid_label_min: Planning grid of 100 planning units. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to select or deselect.
grid_label_elsa: Planning grid of 100 planning units. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to apply the chosen action.
details_hint: Point to or select a planning unit to see its values.
targets_met: All targets are met. Now compare your answer with the computer's.
showing_best: You are looking at the best answer, calculated with prioritizr. Your own map is kept.
showing_search: You are looking at the computer's search result (simulated annealing). Your own map is kept.
best_unavailable: The best answer was calculated for the default area-based targets and weights only. Choose “Reset settings”, or let the computer search.
lock_in: Lock in the existing protected area for Protect
limit_reached: The area-based target for {action} is used up ({limit} planning units). Remove the action from another planning unit first, or raise the target.
lockin_min: With the lock-in on, the Protect target must be at least {n} planning units.
